about.title: About
paragraphs: A Software Engineering student at Western University passionate about building resilient, high-performance systems at the intersection of AI, robotics, and cloud-native infrastructure.

Currently leading a full autonomous VTOL mission system at [Western Aero Design](#experience), building predictive maintenance models at [Motorshield](#experience), and architecting a computer vision analysis platform for [Canada Basketball](#experience).

I thrive in deep technical challenges — from PX4 firmware and LoRa telemetry to CNN/Transformer architectures and scalable data pipelines. Previously modernized enterprise data infrastructure at [Ajinomoto Foods](#experience), identifying over $150,000 in annual savings.
